title: Tai Tam Intermediate Reservoir Dam

terrainReference.basis: Original Lands Department terrain sampled near the mapped main crest midpoint.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap native Intermediate Reservoir structure and shoreline
mapIdentity.scope: Mapped 14-point dam outline from way 323624579, including six shared shoreline points with the named Intermediate Reservoir. The government 5 m terrain records the narrow drop below the dam and the adjoining banks.

note: Masonry-faced gravity wall, lowered north spillway, concrete stilling-basin sidewalls and tubular steel guards. The downstream bed follows the original topography.
